department: Department of Civil and Environmental Engineering

deadline.value: The university's standard PhD deadline for Fall is February 15; the program page does not give its own date.
deadline.quote: Ph.D. applications & supporting documents | December 1 | February 15 | August 1

supervisor.value: The dissertation committee is set up after admission, so admission does not depend on a supervisor's agreement.
supervisor.quote: The student’s dissertation committee should be appointed as soon as possible and within the 15-month period after the student has been admitted to the Ph.D. program

funding.value: The page does not describe funding for this PhD.

entry_route.value: A master's degree in civil or environmental engineering is expected; other applicants are reviewed case by case.
entry_route.quote: Master’s degree in Civil Engineering or Environmental Engineering (only if pursuing Environmental area of specialization) from an accredited institution

notes: Requires a GPA of at least 3.3/4.0 in the master's program per the department page.
